page: Google Cloud Platform n2-highmem-128 is an x86_64 server instance optimized for memory-dense and highly parallelized computational workloads. Powered by an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.6 GHz, the system provides 128 dedicated vCPUs distributed across 64 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading. Cache resources include 48 KB L1 data cache, 1 MB L2 cache, and a shared 54 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX-512 with VNNI, AES-NI, and VAES. System memory is provisioned at 864 GB, offering an elevated memory-to-vCPU allocation of 6.75 GB per thread.

Benchmark measurements indicate strong multi-core scalability and substantial memory throughput. The instance achieves a PassMark CPU score of 84,295.77 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 17,383.0, both placing in the top quartile of tested instances. Memory bandwidth reaches 329.21 GB/sec for large-block read operations and 141.27 GB/sec for uncached writes. Cryptographic throughput is top tier, evidenced by a PassMark encryption score of 104,927.78 assisted by hardware VAES instructions. High-concurrency data operations are similarly capable, delivering 109.06 million operations per second in Redis SET evaluations and a static web serving throughput of 73.26 GB/sec.

The primary architectural tradeoffs involve storage, acceleration, and per-thread clock frequencies. The configuration includes no bundled local NVMe storage and no discrete GPUs, requiring external network block storage for persistent data and rendering large-scale generative AI inference inefficient, as seen in the 2.68 tokens/sec score for 70B model generation. With moderate single-core baseline speeds offset by massive multi-threaded capacity and an extensive 864 GB RAM footprint, the instance is well suited for large in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, enterprise application runtimes, and large-scale compilation tasks.
description: Google Cloud Platform n2-highmem-128 is a memory-dense compute instance featuring 128 dedicated vCPUs across 64 physical Intel Xeon cores at 2.6 GHz and 864 GB of system RAM. Utilizing x86_64 architecture with AVX-512 and VAES support, the system provides strong multi-threaded execution and high memory throughput, recording 329.21 GB/sec in large-block memory reads and 109.06 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks. The configuration lacks integrated local disks and hardware accelerators, requiring external block storage and exhibiting lower efficiency in large-parameter language model generation. The elevated 6.75 GB RAM-per-vCPU allocation and top-quartile parallel compute scores make this instance well matched for in-memory databases, caching infrastructure, software compilation, and large enterprise application workloads.
